mapper.select: SELECT P.PORTFOLIO_NAME FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO P WHERE P.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT P.FINPROD_ABBR FROM FIN_PRODUCT P WHERE P.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or P.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select TRADE_ID from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE where TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT nvl(T1.ENTRUST_AMT, 0) - nvl(T2.FINISH_AMT, 0) - nvl(T3.ENT_FINISH_AMT, 0) FROM (SELECT SUM(nvl(ETR_ENTRUST.ENTRUST_AMT,ETR_ENTRUST.entrust_num*100)) ENTRUST_AMT FROM ETR_ENTRUST WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) T1, (SELECT SUM(FINISH_AMT) FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) T2, (SELECT SUM(EFS.ENT_FINISH_AMT) ENT_FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS EFS WHERE EFS.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD_PRE DAP WHERE DAP.ENTRUST_ID = EFS.ENTRUST_ID AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE TPD WHERE TPD.TRADE_ID = DAP.TRADE_ID))) T3
mapper.insert: insert into WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE (TRADE_ID, WORKFLOW_STATUS, BUSI_TYPE, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH, TRADE_DATE, VDATE, MDATE, SETTLE_DATE, SETTLE_SPEED, CCY, CPRICE_DATE, UNIT_CPRICE, UNIT_INT, UNIT_FPRICE, PAR_VALUE, CPRICE_AMT, SHARE_AMT, PRIN_AMT, INT_AMT, FPRICE_AMT, FEE_AMT_PAY, TRADE_AMT, FEE_AMT_UNPAY, FEE_AMT, PS, YIELD, EXER_YIELD, INV_AIM, TRADE_STATUS, IS_CANCEL, P_TRADE_ID, IS_CLEAN, TOTLE_TRADE_ID, R_TRADE_ID, B_TRADE_ID, CHL_ID, COUNTER_ID, IS_OUT_TRADE, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_PLAT, TRADE_MARKET_MODE, TRADER, COUNTER_TRADER, COUNTER_CONTACT, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, F_TRADE_ID, CASH_ID, REGIST_ORG, REMARK, CANCEL_REMARK, WORKFLOW_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select TRADE_ID || 'R', #{workflowStatus}, BUSI_TYPE, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH, TRADE_DATE, VDATE, MDATE, SETTLE_DATE, SETTLE_SPEED, CCY, CPRICE_DATE, UNIT_CPRICE, UNIT_INT, UNIT_FPRICE, PAR_VALUE, CPRICE_AMT, SHARE_AMT, PRIN_AMT, INT_AMT, FPRICE_AMT, FEE_AMT_PAY, TRADE_AMT, FEE_AMT_UNPAY, FEE_AMT, PS, YIELD, EXER_YIELD, INV_AIM, ${REVOKE_TRADE_STATUS}, IS_CANCEL, TRADE_ID,/*原交易编号*/ IS_CLEAN, TOTLE_TRADE_ID || 'R', R_TRADE_ID, B_TRADE_ID, CHL_ID, COUNTER_ID, IS_OUT_TRADE, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_PLAT, TRADE_MARKET_MODE, TRADER, COUNTER_TRADER, COUNTER_CONTACT, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, F_TRADE_ID, CASH_ID, REGIST_ORG, REMARK, CANCEL_REMARK, #{workflowId}, #{user}, #{dept}, #{time, jdbcType=DATE}, #{user}, #{time, jdbcType=DATE} from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}

insert into WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD_PRE (TRADE_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, GEN_TYPE, REG_DATE, REG_DATE_AMT, ENTRUST_ID, PAY_TYPE, TERM_TYPE, WORKFLOW_STATUS, WORKFLOW_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select TRADE_ID || 'R', PORTFOLIO_ID, GEN_TYPE, REG_DATE, REG_DATE_AMT, ENTRUST_ID, PAY_TYPE, TERM_TYPE, #{workflowStatus}, #{workflowId}, #{user}, #{dept}, #{time, jdbcType=DATE}, #{user}, #{time, jdbcType=DATE} from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD_PRE where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}

insert into TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE (TRADE_ID, BUSI_TYPE, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH, TRADE_DATE, VDATE, MDATE, SETTLE_DATE, SETTLE_SPEED, CCY, CPRICE_DATE, UNIT_CPRICE, UNIT_INT, UNIT_FPRICE, PAR_VALUE, CPRICE_AMT, SHARE_AMT, PRIN_AMT, INT_AMT, FPRICE_AMT, FEE_AMT_PAY, TRADE_AMT, FEE_AMT_UNPAY, FEE_AMT, PS, YIELD, EXER_YIELD, INV_AIM, TRADE_STATUS, IS_CANCEL, P_TRADE_ID, IS_CLEAN, TOTLE_TRADE_ID, R_TRADE_ID, B_TRADE_ID, CHL_ID, COUNTER_ID, IS_OUT_TRADE, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_PLAT, TRADE_MARKET_MODE, TRADER, COUNTER_TRADER, COUNTER_CONTACT, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, F_TRADE_ID, CASH_ID, REGIST_ORG, REMARK, CANCEL_REMARK, WORKFLOW_ID, WORKFLOW_STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select TRADE_ID || 'R', BUSI_TYPE, FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH, TRADE_DATE, VDATE, MDATE, SETTLE_DATE, SETTLE_SPEED, CCY, CPRICE_DATE, UNIT_CPRICE, UNIT_INT, UNIT_FPRICE, PAR_VALUE, CPRICE_AMT, SHARE_AMT, PRIN_AMT, INT_AMT, FPRICE_AMT, FEE_AMT_PAY, TRADE_AMT, FEE_AMT_UNPAY, FEE_AMT, PS, YIELD, EXER_YIELD, INV_AIM, ${REVOKE_TRADE_STATUS}, #{isCancel}, TRADE_ID,/*原交易编号*/ IS_CLEAN, TOTLE_TRADE_ID || 'R', R_TRADE_ID, B_TRADE_ID, CHL_ID, COUNTER_ID, IS_OUT_TRADE, TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_PLAT, TRADE_MARKET_MODE, TRADER, COUNTER_TRADER, COUNTER_CONTACT, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, F_TRADE_ID, CASH_ID, REGIST_ORG, REMARK, #{revokeReason}, #{workflowId}, #{workflowStatus}, #{user}, #{dept}, #{time, jdbcType=DATE}, #{user}, #{time, jdbcType=DATE} from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE where TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode, jdbcType = VARCHAR}

insert into TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD_PRE (TRADE_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, GEN_TYPE, REG_DATE, REG_DATE_AMT, ENTRUST_ID, PAY_TYPE, TERM_TYPE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select T1.TRADE_ID || 'R', T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.GEN_TYPE, T1.REG_DATE, T1.REG_DATE_AMT, T1.ENTRUST_ID, T1.PAY_TYPE, T1.TERM_TYPE, #{user}, #{dept}, #{time, jdbcType=DATE}, #{user}, #{time, jdbcType=DATE} from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD_PRE T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE ON T1.TRADE_ID = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE.TRADE_ID where TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE_PRE T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE T2 WHERE T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID AND T2.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId, jdbcType = VARCHAR})

DELETE FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE T2 WHERE T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID AND T2.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} union all SELECT 1 FROM wfl_reg_fin_product_deal T3 WHERE T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID AND T3.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} )

DELETE FROM PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE T2 WHERE T1.ORDER_ID = T2.TRADE_ID AND T2.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} union all SELECT 1 FROM wfl_reg_fin_product_deal T3 WHERE T1.ORDER_ID = T3.TRADE_ID AND T3.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} )

DELETE FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION_FLOW T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE T2 WHERE T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID AND T2.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} union all SELECT 1 FROM wfl_reg_fin_product_deal T3 WHERE T1.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID AND T3.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} )

DELETE FROM ETR_CASH_POSITION_FLOW T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE T2 WHERE T1.ORDER_ID = T2.TRADE_ID AND T2.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} union all SELECT 1 FROM wfl_reg_fin_product_deal T3 WHERE T1.ORDER_ID = T3.TRADE_ID AND T3.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} )
